name: spec
description: Guide bounded spec-driven coding work, reuse project sources, and check document structure and evidence freshness.

interface.longDescription: Three local coding workflows: project orientation and planning, fresh-context design review, and bounded implementation with verification. Includes a companion Go CLI checker for mapped documents and evidence hashes. Semantic judgments and project checks remain explicit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use SPEC to define this project and guide its next spec-driven step.
